discord-thread-naming-backstop-workflow 1.0.0 – initial release

- Provides a workflow for silently checking and correcting recent Discord thread names in a specific parent channel of a target guild.
- Strictly limits scope: only targets new threads (created within 20 minutes or today with clearly abnormal titles) in channel `1478785965580357754`.
- Skips threads already matching a preset naming convention (`^【[^】]+】.+ - \d{8}$`), avoids historical or unrelated threads.
- Auto-generates compliant names using a fixed template and extracts thread intent/type based on whitelist and heuristics.
- Handles Discord API retries, applies final consistency checks, and sends alert (P2) or resolved notifications only if needed—normal runs remain silent.
- Limits each run to at most three threads and ensures non-disruptive, traceable operation.
